Wave Structure |active_in = [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies have high defenses, tank and bloated modifiers.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Juggernaut''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in the [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] challenge. It affects enemy stats, making them overall stronger. To compensate, it also boosts starting cash and wave bonus cash. ==Effects== '''Juggernaut''' modifier has three main changes to enemies. It applies the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute to multiple enemies, increases every enemy's defense by 50% and gives every enemy the [[Bloated]] attribute. ===Tank=== The [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute is only applied to these enemies: *[[Abnormal]] *[[Quick]] *[[Heavy]] *[[Abnormal Boss]] *[[Shadow]] *[[Breaker2]] *[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] **Removed on Wave 26, re-added for every wave after. *[[Hazard]] ==Update History== *'''21 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0]] **'''Juggernaut''' added. *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Juggernaut''' can now be exclusively activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode through [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] challenge. ==Notes== {{ModifierNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Juggernaut}}
